en: Every attack has a type modifier. Standard is 1x. Super Effective is 2x. Not Very Effective is 0.5x. Immunities are 0x.

en: While it depends on the strategy, the **Steel** type is often considered the best defensive type due to its numerous resistances, while **Fairy** and **Dragon** are top-tier offensive types in Gen 9.
es: Depende de la estrategia: ningún tipo es el mejor en todos los casos. Acero destaca en defensa por sus múltiples resistencias, mientras que Hada y Dragón son tipos ofensivos muy valorados en la Gen 9.

en: To calculate dual type effectiveness, multiply the modifiers of both types. For example, if both types are weak to Water, the Pokemon takes 4x damage.
es: Se multiplican los modificadores de efectividad de ambos tipos. Por ejemplo, si los dos tipos son débiles al tipo Agua (x2 cada uno), el Pokémon recibe x4 de daño; si uno es débil (x2) y el otro resiste (x0,5), el daño queda en x1.

en: Pokemon Scarlet and Violet (Gen 9) maintains the 18 standard types but introduces the **Terastal** phenomenon, allowing Pokemon to change their type mid-battle.
es: No. La novena generación (Pokémon Escarlata y Púrpura) mantiene los 18 tipos existentes. La novedad es la teracristalización, que permite a un Pokémon cambiar su tipo durante el combate.

en: Yes, **Immunities** result in 0x damage. For example, Ghost types are immune to Normal and Fighting moves, and Ground types are immune to Electric attacks.
es: Sí. Una inmunidad hace que el ataque no cause daño (x0). Por ejemplo, el tipo Fantasma es inmune a los movimientos de tipo Normal y Lucha, y el tipo Tierra es inmune a los de tipo Eléctrico. Un Pokémon de dos tipos es inmune si cualquiera de sus dos tipos lo es.

en: Understanding type effectiveness is crucial for any Pokemon trainer, whether you're playing Pokemon Scarlet and Violet (Gen 9) or classic titles. Our Pokemon Type Calculator helps you instantly find weaknesses, resistances, and immunities for any single or dual-type Pokemon.

Many Pokemon possess two types (e.g., Charizard is Fire/Flying). Weaknesses stack! If both types are weak to the same element (like Rock vs. Fire/Flying), the damage multiplier becomes 4x. Conversely, resistances can cancel out weaknesses.

Every attack in the game has a type modifier. A standard attack deals 1x damage. If a move is Super Effective, it deals 2x damage. If it's Not Very Effective, it deals 0.5x damage. Immunities result in 0x damage, meaning the attack has no effect at all.
Quickly analyze type coverage, weaknesses, and resistances for any Pokemon or type combination.
